resources.string: HermesSIM is running. Tap for details.
Setting up this phone as your host
Your phone uses the SIM card in this phone
This phone can\'t be used as a host
This phone\'s processor isn\'t supported. HermesSIM only runs on phones with an ARM processor.
This phone\'s bootloader can\'t be unlocked, so the phone can\'t be rooted.
If you have another spare phone, you can check whether it works in the HermesSIM app under Host → Check a phone.
To root the phone, you first need to unlock its bootloader. Go to Settings → About phone and tap Build number 7 times to turn on Developer options. Then turn on OEM unlocking in Developer options.

On Samsung phones: Turn the phone off. Hold Volume Up and Volume Down while you plug in the USB cable, then press and hold Volume Up to unlock. If you don\'t see OEM unlocking, keep the phone connected to the internet for a few days and check again.

On Xiaomi, Redmi and POCO phones: Link your Mi account in Developer options → Mi Unlock status. Then unlock the phone with the Mi Unlock tool on a computer. Xiaomi usually makes you wait 7 days before it unlocks.
On Pixel phones: With the phone in fastboot mode, run \"fastboot flashing unlock\" on a computer. Pixel phones bought from Verizon can\'t be unlocked.
On Motorola and Sony phones: Get an unlock code from the maker\'s website, then run the fastboot command shown there.
Then, with the phone in fastboot mode, run \"fastboot flashing unlock\" on a computer.
Unlocking erases everything on the phone. After that, root the phone with Magisk and install HermesSIM-Host-Magisk.zip in Magisk → Modules.
This phone\'s bootloader can\'t be unlocked.

Install the Magisk app. Use it to patch this phone\'s boot image, then flash the patched image to the phone (on Samsung phones, use Odin). The Magisk guide has the steps for your phone. Then install HermesSIM-Host-Magisk.zip in Magisk → Modules and restart the phone.
Checking root… If Magisk asks, tap Grant.
This phone isn\'t rooted. Install Magisk first. The Magisk guide has the steps.
%1$s didn\'t respond. Tap Check root again, and tap Grant when %1$s asks.
Root access was denied. In %1$s → Superuser, allow HermesSIM Host. Then check again.

Root is working. Download HermesSIM-Host-Magisk.zip from hermessim.keremgok.tr. In the Magisk app, go to Modules → Install from storage and choose that file. Then restart the phone. HermesSIM starts on its own when the phone turns on, and setup picks up here where it left off.
%s. Try again. If the problem continues, send a report below.
The module is installed. Restart the phone. HermesSIM starts on its own when the phone turns on, and setup picks up here where it left off.
The module is turned off in %1$s → %2$s. Turn it on there, then restart the phone.
%1$s will remove the module the next time the phone starts. To keep using HermesSIM, install HermesSIM-Host-Magisk.zip again in %1$s → %2$s, then restart the phone.
The module is no longer installed. Install HermesSIM-Host-Magisk.zip in %1$s → %2$s, then restart the phone.
The module is installed. Restart the phone to start it.
The phone restarted, but HermesSIM didn\'t start as a system app. Reinstall the module. If the problem continues, send a report below.
The HermesSIM background service isn\'t running. Restart the phone. If the service still doesn\'t run, reinstall the module.
HermesSIM isn\'t running as a system app, so it\'s missing these abilities: %s. Reinstall the module and restart the phone.
HermesSIM isn\'t the default SMS app.
Battery saving may stop HermesSIM from running.
The phone isn\'t fully silenced yet.
Bluetooth is off. Your phone connects to this one over Bluetooth.
Tap Fix now and HermesSIM will set all of this up for you.

Install and open the HermesSIM app on your phone (iPhone or Android). Tap Add host and choose \"%1$s\" from the list. When your phone asks you to confirm pairing, confirm it. Then enter the code below.
PIN, pattern or password. After a restart, HermesSIM can\'t run until someone unlocks the phone
None. HermesSIM starts on its own after a restart

Set the screen lock to None or Swipe. With a PIN, pattern or password, HermesSIM can\'t run after the phone restarts until someone unlocks it, and nobody is around to unlock a phone left in a bag or at home.

Paired with %1$s. Now, in the HermesSIM app on your phone, go to Host → Call audio and tap Run the call test. Then call a friend, and keep this phone next to you so you can hear whether any sound comes from it.
This phone\'s software was updated after its call test. To turn full voice back on, run the call test again from the HermesSIM app on your phone.
Paired with %1$s. Call audio isn\'t supported on this phone yet, so it runs in Basic mode: texts, call control and the hotspot work. Now turn on Box mode from the HermesSIM app on your phone.
Paired with %1$s, and full voice is on. As a last step, turn on Box mode from the HermesSIM app on your phone so this phone\'s screen stays off.
No SIM card found. Insert a SIM card and make sure it\'s seated properly. HermesSIM picks it up on its own.
SIM %d is locked. Enter its PIN in the HermesSIM app on your phone (Host → SIM).
Keep it charged. You can take it with you (a bag is fine) or leave it at home. To open this screen again, press Volume Up 3 times, then Volume Down 3 times.
If another phone connects in the next 5 minutes, it will be paired instead of %1$s. If no other phone connects, %1$s stays paired. Continue?
Verified: the HermesSIM team has tested call audio on this phone.
Expected to work: this phone\'s software matches the audio system of a verified phone. Call audio turns on after a short call test.
Experimental: the HermesSIM audio system hasn\'t been tested on this phone yet. Call audio needs a call test before it turns on.
Basic mode: HermesSIM can\'t carry call audio on this phone yet. Texts, call control and the hotspot work.
This phone hasn\'t been tested yet. Texts, call control and the hotspot should work (Basic mode). A call test will show whether call audio works.
Phone, SMS and Bluetooth permissions are granted. HermesSIM is the default phone and SMS app. Battery saving won\'t stop it. The phone is silenced.
On. Your phone can find this one
This phone can\'t make itself visible over Bluetooth LE, so your phone can\'t connect to it.
This phone doesn\'t have Bluetooth LE, so your phone can\'t connect to it.
On. It will be checked again once HermesSIM starts
Another app is using this phone\'s Bluetooth broadcast channel. Trying again every minute.
Android couldn\'t start the Bluetooth broadcast (code %1$d). Trying again.
%s is paired but out of Bluetooth range right now
Full voice: the call test passed on this phone
Ready for the call test. Start it from the HermesSIM app on your phone
Basic mode: call audio isn\'t supported on this phone yet
Charges when the battery drops below %1$d%%. Above %2$d%%, charging stops and the phone runs on battery.
Off. You can turn it on from the HermesSIM app on your phone once setup is done
Phones list this host by this name. The phone\'s Bluetooth and its hotspot use the same name.

resources.string: Android couldn\'t save this name. Make sure Bluetooth is on and try again.
Something went wrong on this screen
The host is still working. Close HermesSIM and open it again. If the error comes back, send a report below so we can fix it.

We receive the phone\'s model and software, the names and value ranges of its sound chip settings (once only), and how setup and calls went. If something goes wrong, a short log is added with phone numbers, addresses and names removed. Your messages, contacts and identity details are never sent. This helps us find out which phones HermesSIM works well on.
The report couldn\'t be sent right now. It will be sent when the phone is back online.
Stop using this phone as a host

The phone goes back to normal. Its sounds, vibration, screen, buttons, its own calling and messaging apps, and Wi-Fi all work as before. Your phone removes this host from its list, and HermesSIM is removed from this phone. The phone restarts at the end. %1$s and the unlocked bootloader stay as they are.

Calls and texts to this SIM card will no longer reach your phone. To use this phone as a host again later, install HermesSIM-Host-Magisk.zip in %1$s → %2$s and pair the phone again.\n\n%1$s (root) and the unlocked bootloader stay as they are, because they were set up before HermesSIM. To return the phone to its factory software, uninstall %1$s from within the %1$s app afterwards.
Undoing the changes made with HermesSIM…
Removing HermesSIM. The phone will restart in a moment.
The removal couldn\'t start. This phone is still working as a host. Try again. If the problem continues, go to %1$s → %2$s, remove the HermesSIM Host module, then restart the phone.
Installing the HermesSIM module: the background service, permissions and silence settings. The phone will restart once when the install is done.
HermesSIM isn\'t the default phone app.
Root access was denied. In %1$s → Superuser, allow HermesSIM Host. Then tap Fix now.

SIM %d is blocked. In the HermesSIM app on your phone, go to Host → SIM and enter the PUK code and a new PIN. The PUK code is printed on the card your SIM came on, or you can get it from your carrier.
This phone is locked to another carrier, so it won\'t accept SIM %d. HermesSIM can\'t remove this lock. Ask the carrier you bought the phone from to unlock it, or use a SIM card from that carrier.
SIM %d is permanently blocked because the wrong PUK code was entered too many times. Ask your carrier for a new SIM card.
Turn the SIM on from the HermesSIM app on your phone (Host → SIM). While it\'s off, you won\'t get calls or texts.
Paused with the button gesture until %s. After that, it turns back on when the screen goes off
Time left to pair: about %d min.
The server didn\'t accept the report. Try again later.
A call is in progress, so nothing was changed. Try again when the call ends.
Root access was denied, so nothing was changed. In %1$s → Superuser, allow HermesSIM Host. Then try again.
The removal couldn\'t be prepared, so nothing was changed. Try again. If the problem continues, send a report below.
Your phone has already removed this host from its list. To keep using it, add it again from the HermesSIM app on your phone with Add host.
This phone is back to normal

The changes you made to this phone with HermesSIM have been undone. The removal finishes when you restart the phone. Until then, the app has no effect on your phone\'s sound, your calls or your texts.\n\nIf HermesSIM is still installed after the restart, go to %1$s → %2$s and remove the HermesSIM Host module. Then restart the phone.

The changes you made to this phone with HermesSIM have been undone, but the HermesSIM Host app is still installed. The app has no effect on your phone\'s sound, your calls or your texts.\n\nTo finish removing it, go to %1$s → %2$s and remove the HermesSIM Host app. Then restart the phone.
